title: Two rooms, two teams
text: Everyone gets a secret card: Crew or Swarm. Split into two real rooms, the station modules.

title: Two key cards
text: The Crew has the Captain. The Swarm has the Mimic. Everyone else is a regular member of a team.

title: Share carefully
text: Show your card to people you trust, from your phone, or keep it hidden. Talk, bluff and work out who is who.

title: Chiefs and the airlock
text: Each room elects a chief. At the end of every round the chiefs send people through the airlock to the other room.

title: Who wins
text: After the last round: if the Mimic is in the same room as the Captain, the Swarm wins. Otherwise the Crew wins.
